grclanker v0.1.1 is a security and dependency update to `v0.1.0`. The tool surface is unchanged: `grclanker tools` still reports 241 domain tools and 7 compute backend tools.

## Security

- **27 of 29 CLI advisories cleared.** `npm audit` in `cli/` goes from 29 advisories (1 critical, 15 high, 13 moderate) to 2 high.
- **Critical `shell-quote` command injection fixed.** `shell-quote` is now 1.12.0.
- **MCP SDK OAuth credential leak fixed.** `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` is now 1.32.1, and `undici` moves from 7.29.0 to 8.10.2.
- **The 2 left are both `node-forge`.** npm counts GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv once for `node-forge` and once for `@anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime`, which pulls it in. No patched `node-forge` exists, and npm's only suggested fix downgrades sandbox-runtime to 0.0.50, so they stay until upstream ships a fix.
- **Site advisories down from 7 to 0.** Astro 7.3.7, Vite 8.3.3, wrangler 4.148, and a `sharp` override clear every site `npm audit` advisory. These were build-time only; the site is static.

## Runtimes

- **Pi 1.1.** grclanker runs on `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 1.1.0, up from 1.0.0.
- **Flue 2.2.2.** Flue now drops a `null` for an optional tool argument instead of turning it into `0`, `false`, or an empty string, as the Pi CLI does.
- **Cursor Agent SDK on `@cursor/bdk` 0.2.21**, up from 0.2.18. The agent project now lives in `cli/agent-sdk/bot/` instead of `cli/agent-sdk/agent/`, the layout the BDK docs use. It still serves all 241 tools: 199 read-only tools and 42 approval-gated writers.

## Installer

- `grclanker.com/install` and `install.ps1` fall back to the `releases/latest` redirect when the GitHub API rate limit is used up, instead of aborting.
- Both installers skip drafts and prereleases, so a tag such as `v0.2.0-rc.1` never becomes the default install.

## Release and CI

- Dependabot now opens weekly npm update PRs for the CLI and the site, with grouped minor, patch, and security updates. `@cursor/bdk` and Pi bumps arrive together in their own group.

## Upgrade notes

- Rerun the installer to upgrade. Settings and runtime state under `~/.grclanker/agent` are kept.
- Source checkouts should rerun `npm --prefix cli ci`, since the CLI lockfile changed.
- If you drive grclanker through Flue and pass `null` for optional arguments, expect the argument to be omitted rather than coerced.

Full changelog: [What's New](https://grclanker.com/docs/changelog/) and [v0.1.0...v0.1.1](https://github.com/ethanolivertroy/grclanker/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1).
